title: Zesty Charred Kenyan Lamb Wrap
description: A romantic Kenyan dish featuring charred lamb, red wine vinegar, and ssam-wrap, perfect for a special occasion, this jain-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together red wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large ziplock bag and pour the marinade over it, making sure the lamb is fully coated.
Seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the lamb to marinate.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook on the preheated grill for about 5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Warm the ssam wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing a few slices of the charred lamb onto a ssam wrap piece and serving immediately.
